messages.text:
"Create a dark fantasy, 18+ arena combat game with realistic physics and brutal melee combat. The player fights waves of armored gladiators, knights, berserkers, and elite champions using swords, war hammers, axes, maces, and other medieval weapons. Combat should feel weighty, responsive, and skill-based, with parries, dodges, blocks, stamina management, and powerful finishing moves.
Enemies react dynamically to hits with realistic physics and visible battle damage appropriate for a mature audience. Battles are fast-paced and cinematic, with destructible armor, environmental hazards, and dynamic blood effects. Include multiple arena types, increasingly difficult enemy waves, unlockable weapons and armor, character progression, boss fights, slow-motion finishing strikes, and high-quality sound effects.
Use realistic lighting, detailed medieval environments, and immersive animations. The focus should be on satisfying, physics-driven melee combat, weapon variety, and challenging arena survival.
"
